newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHALKE BLAME BRUGGE FOR UEFA CUP CROWD TROUBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE BLAME BRUGGE FOR UEFA CUP CROWD TROUBLE.

text.p: German first division side Schalke have blamed Club Brugge for poor security at an UEFA Cup match in Belgium on Tuesday during which Schalke fans caused damage and set off fireworks.
In a letter to UEFA on Thursday, Schalke officials said their club should not be held responsible for the damage because Brugge failed to provide adequate security.
Brugge won the third round, first leg 2-1.
